Based on the packaging label provided in the image, here is the complete transcription of all the text declarations following Legal Metrology standards:

### **Text Declarations:**

* **Product Name & Type:** ALCOHOL (DENATURED) DISINFECTANT HAND SANITIZER / DETTOL INSTANT HAND SANITIZER
* **Key Benefits:** Dettol Hand Sanitizer kills 99.9% of germs instantly, without water. Use anytime, anywhere: car, office, handbag, picnics, nappy change, travel, sports etc. Leaves your hands refreshed. Use as often as required.
* **Ingredients:** Alcohol IP (Denatured) eq. to absolute alcohol 72.34% v/v, Water, PEG/PPG-17/6 Copolymer, Propylene Glycol, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Tetrahydroxypropylethylenediamine, Perfume.
* **How to Use:** Take a thumbnail size drop on your palm and rub your hands briskly until dry.
* **Caution:** Keep away from fire or flame and children. Avoid use on/around eyes, ears, mouth, genitalia, broken/irritated skin or large areas of body. In case of contact with eye, rinse thoroughly with water. In case of irritation, discontinue use. Consult a doctor if irritation persists or product is swallowed.
* **FOR EXTERNAL USE ONLY.**
* **Storage Condition:** Store in a Cool, Dry Place.
* **Net Vol.:** 60ml
* **MRP (Incl. of all taxes):** ₹ 45 *Promo Price (Overwritten on Rs. 60)
* **Manufacturer Info:** 
  * **Mfd. by:** M/s Allkind Healthcare, Unit-II, Plot No. 114-A, Khasra Nos. 2214/2036/1785, 2219/2037/1785, 2224/2038/1785, EPIP, Phase-II, Village & Post Thana, Tehsil-Baddi, District-Solan (Himachal Pradesh), PIN-173205.
  * **Mfg. Lic. No.:** MNB/21/1133, State Excise Lic. in Form L-19A.
* **Marketed by / For Consumer Complaints contact:**
  * Reckitt Benckiser Consumer Care at: Reckitt Benckiser (India) Pvt. Ltd., DLF Cyber Park, 6th & 7th Floor (Tower C), 405 B, Udyog Vihar Phase III, Sector 20, Gurugram-122016.
  * **Toll Free Number:** 18001035012
  * **Email:** ConsumerHealth_India@rb.com
* **Batch No. / Mfd. & Exp. Date:** 
  * **Mfd., Batch No. & Exp.:** See pack.
  * **Printed details:** 01/22 BKA072009 12/23 (Mfg: 01/22, Exp: 12/23)
* **Barcodes / Identifiers:** 
  * 8 901396 387039 >
  * 3200698 (and QR/Data Matrix code)
